_comment: CAPABILITY suite for the PostgreSQL CDC stream source with initial_load, over every table of the employees model and its xp_sentinel (functions/caps_postgrescdc_initial_load.py::postgrescdc_initial_load). STAGES, in order: (1) domains -- create the postgrescdc domain, install the employees model, load the xs seed; (2) live -- `tdd domain sentinel-data --key after-create-data`, one xp_sentinel row stamped after the seed, so the snapshot carries it; (3) collections -- the project and one postgres_cdc source collection; (4) functions -- register the @stream_publisher, which STARTS it (no trigger): with initial_load=True it first emits a snapshot of each tracked table (rows as inserts, a LOAD control row per table ahead of them), then captures changes from the snapshot's position, over the domain's own replication slot (created with the domain, named after it, replication_slot_behavior=reuse); (5) sentinel -- hold until the after-create-data key is in a version of xp_sentinel_changes (at most 5m) -- the snapshot carried it, so its arrival means the load has flushed; (6) monitor watches their transactions. Nothing changes the tables here: the load is the whole seed plus the sentinel and no change follows it; postgrescdc_initial_load_live is the same with changes running throughout. Seven output tables, <table>_changes, xp_sentinel_changes among them. The slot pins WAL until the domain is destroyed, which drops it. Run: `tdd xp one-shot --suite container-connectors/postgrescdc_initial_load --keep`, then `tdk worker list` / `tdk table sample`.
